title: Fresh encrypted production backup and isolated recovery verified
summary: Production read-only backup and encrypted archive integrity passed. Isolated application restore verified 110 table hashes and sequences; local cluster stopped. Official launch remains NO-GO.

changes.detail: Fixed Windows pg_ctl inherited-pipe stall by redirecting control output to a local file. Preserved the failed attempt and manually stopped only the named test cluster before retry.

Recorded encrypted fresh production backup, independent saved-key decryption, successful isolated restore and explicit remaining production gates. No production writes, migrations, deployment, secret changes or deletions.

validation.name: Encrypted backup integrity
validation.detail: Snapshot 2026-10-21T17:06:27.777Z; AES-256-GCM authentication, ciphertext/plaintext checksums and full archive read passed; 1233 entries. TLS and read-only production identity passed.

validation.name: Isolated recovery
validation.detail: 110 included table hashes and sequence values match; 61 public RLS tables; no owner/ACL restore errors; zero foreign servers/subscriptions/outbound managed extensions. Independent DPAPI key recovery passed. Local cluster shutdown passed.

validation.name: Initial local attempt
validation.detail: Windows subprocess I/O stall required manual local-cluster stop; first runner subsequently recorded ECONNREFUSED and redundant-stop failure. Corrected second attempt passed; old evidence retained.

validation.name: Remaining limitations
validation.detail: 38 managed-service/event-trigger entries excluded from local restore; PG18.6 local versus PG17.6 production; 205 Storage object binaries not backed up. Offsite/key disaster recovery, authenticated staging acceptance, production bindings/build and launch authorization remain open. No full-platform recovery claim.
